editorial.blurb: Red Dragon Buffet offers a peaceful, family-friendly setting with consistently fresh, hot food and a sushi bar alongside a well-stocked spread of Japanese and Chinese classics.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask about their seafood options—reviewers rave about the shrimp and fish dishes, which are surprisingly generous for a buffet. Come at off-peak times to enjoy the quiet atmosphere.

topDishes.note: Part of their expanded sushi bar; reviewers drove 25 minutes for it
